description: Plate blur + pHash (BE-2.4/2.5, 10-integrations-api §2.4). Multipart request. Core API decoder: api/src/lib/ml-client.ts mlBlur (snake_case → camelCase; blurred_image_b64 → Buffer). Contract = response KEYS and TYPES. blurred_image_b64 below is a short placeholder base64 (decodes to bytes) — the live endpoint returns a full JPEG.

multipart.regions: optional JSON array of normalized [0..1] boxes: [{"x":0.25,"y":0.25,"width":0.5,"height":0.5}]
